001package iscteiul.ista.battleship;
002
003import java.util.List;
004
005/**
006 * Defines a collection of ships placed on a square Battleship board.
007 * Provides placement validation, ship lookup and fleet status operations.
008 */
009public interface IFleet {
010    /** Number of rows and columns on the board. */
011    Integer BOARD_SIZE = 10;
012    /** Fleet size threshold used when adding ships. */
013    Integer FLEET_SIZE = 10;
014
015    /**
016     * Returns the ships currently in the fleet.
017     *
018     * @return the fleet's mutable list of ships
019     */
020    List<IShip> getShips();
021
022    /**
023     * Attempts to add a ship subject to fleet capacity and placement checks.
024     * The ship must fit inside the board and must not overlap or touch another
025     * ship, including diagonally.
026     *
027     * @param s the non-null ship to add
028     * @return {@code true} if the ship was added; {@code false} if a check failed
029     */
030    boolean addShip(IShip s);
031
032    /**
033     * Selects ships with the given category name, using case-sensitive matching.
034     *
035     * @param category the category to select
036     * @return a new list containing the matching ships
037     */
038    List<IShip> getShipsLike(String category);
039
040    /**
041     * Selects ships that still have at least one unhit position.
042     *
043     * @return a new list containing the ships still afloat
044     */
045    List<IShip> getFloatingShips();
046
047    /**
048     * Finds the first ship occupying the supplied coordinates.
049     *
050     * @param pos the non-null position to inspect
051     * @return the occupying ship, or {@code null} if no ship occupies the position
052     */
053    IShip shipAt(IPosition pos);
054
055    /** Prints all ships, the ships still afloat and the ships in each category. */
056    void printStatus();
057}
